title: Backing Track API
description: Jobs, LLM calls and tokens, Voyage retries, APNs pushes and API traffic. Built on the conventions in ADR 0044.

panels.title: Jobs finished
panels.description: Jobs that reached a terminal state in the selected range. Jobs are held in memory, so a restart resets the underlying counter (increase() copes with that); a job lost to a crash is never counted.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Complete or completed via fallback, as a share of every job that finished (cancelled jobs count against it).

panels.title: Via fallback
panels.description: Share of finished jobs that fell back to the rule-based generator after the LLM path ran out of attempts.

targets.expr: (sum((last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total{outcome="completed_via_fallback"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total{outcome="completed_via_fallback"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total{outcome="completed_via_fallback"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)) / sum((last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total[$__range]) - (last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(generation_job_completed_total[$__range]))))

panels.title: Evicted from store
panels.description: Finished jobs removed from the in-memory store by the TTL sweep.

panels.title: Queue depth and jobs in the store
panels.description: Queue depth counts jobs waiting for the worker, including any cancelled while pending until the worker skips them. Store counts are live in-memory state and reset on restart.

panels.title: Attempts used per job
panels.description: How many validate/repair attempts a job used before it finished. Only recorded when an attempt count exists, so the total differs from 'Jobs finished'.

panels.title: Calls by step and outcome
panels.description: A response with no usable result counts as a failure, matching what the workflow does with it.

targets.expr: (sum((last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)) / sum((last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total[$__range]) - (last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(track_generation_calls_total[$__range]))))

(sum((last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)) / sum((last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total[$__range]) - (last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(track_repair_calls_total[$__range]))))

(sum((last_over_time(critic_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(critic_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(critic_calls_total{outcome="failure"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)) / sum((last_over_time(critic_calls_total[$__range]) - (last_over_time(critic_calls_total[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(critic_calls_total[$__range]))))

panels.title: p95 latency by step (selected range)
panels.description: Computed over the whole range rather than a rate, so it is meaningful at low traffic. Bucket boundaries are in Constants (see ADR 0044).

panels.title: Mean latency by step and service tier
panels.description: Flex and default tiers are priced and queued differently; unset is reported as not_specified.

targets.expr: sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(track_generation_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]))))

sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(track_repair_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]))))

sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (service_tier)((last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(critic_call_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Input tokens by step and service tier
panels.description: Token histograms still use default buckets, so read them as sums and means rather than percentiles. Includes the tokens of failed calls that returned a response (critic).

panels.title: Output tokens by step and service tier
Embedding calls
panels.description: Calls through the Voyage client's resilience pipeline, retries included in one call.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Attempts after the first. Polly's own telemetry, exported via the Polly meter.

targets.expr: (sum((last_over_time(resilience_polly_strategy_attempt_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard",attempt_number!="0"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(resilience_polly_strategy_attempt_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard",attempt_number!="0"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(resilience_polly_strategy_attempt_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard",attempt_number!="0"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)) / sum((last_over_time(resilience_polly_pipeline_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(resilience_polly_pipeline_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(resilience_polly_pipeline_duration_milliseconds_count{pipeline_name="IQueryEmbeddingService-standard"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: Calls that still failed after the retries ran out.

panels.title: p95 duration (selected range)
panels.description: Total time per call including backoff between retries. Polly reports milliseconds, unlike our own _seconds histograms.

panels.title: Retries by status
panels.description: The HTTP status (or exception) that caused each retry.

panels.title: Push success rate
panels.description: Attempts only: jobs with no device token, and the no-op emitter when APNs is not configured, are not counted.

panels.title: p95 push latency (selected range)
panels.description: The client times out at 10s.

panels.title: Rejections by status and reason
panels.description: Reason is APNs' own, capped at 50 characters (longer or missing is 'unknown'). BadDeviceToken / Unregistered point at stale tokens; ExpiredProviderToken or a 403 points at the signing key.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome)((last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (outcome)((last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) - (last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval] offset $__rate_interval) or 0 * last_over_time(push_notification_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]))))

sum((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code=~"5..", http_route!~"/healthz.*"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code=~"5..", http_route!~"/healthz.*"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code=~"5..", http_route!~"/healthz.*"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: 429 rate-limited
panels.description: Requests rejected by the per-API-key rate limiter.

panels.title: 503 queue unavailable
panels.description: The queue is unbounded, so this only happens once shutdown has completed the channel.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code="503", http_route="/tracks/generate"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code="503", http_route="/tracks/generate"}[$__range] offset $__range) or 0 * last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code="503", http_route="/tracks/generate"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)
